## Adding labels

We can specify labels, titles, and other formatting elements by reading the [documentation](https://matplotlib.org/stable/api/_as_gen/matplotlib.pyplot.html#module-matplotlib.pyplot) or following a [tutorial](https://matplotlib.org/stable/tutorials/introductory/pyplot.html):
code_block:
def run_module(ctx):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
    from scipy import stats
    import sklearn
    from sklearn import metrics, model_selection, linear_model, cluster, decomposition, preprocessing, ensemble, tree, neighbors, svm, mixture
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot([1, 2, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6, 10])
    ax.set_title('An example pyplot chart')
    ax.set_xlabel('x')
    ax.set_ylabel('y')
    ctx['viz'] = fig
raw_code:
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6, 10])
ax.set_title('An example pyplot chart')
ax.set_xlabel('x')
ax.set_ylabel('y')
